claims.text: Clinician note documents rising creatinine with dehydration and states a plan to hold furosemide and repeat kidney function in 48 hours.

citations.quote: Hold furosemide and repeat kidney function in 48 hours.

claims.text: A May entry records continuing furosemide 40 mg each morning.
The record contains a medication conflict for furosemide: one entry says continue it and a later clinician note says hold it.

open_questions: No allergy or reaction is documented in the available entries; confirm allergy status.

No creatinine or kidney function values are recorded in the entries before the recent rise; obtain prior results.
No weight values are recorded; the vitals entries state only that weight and pulse were unchanged. How long has dehydration been documented?
Whether the plan to hold furosemide and repeat kidney function in 48 hours was carried out is not documented.
Which follow-ups, referrals or tests are planned or outstanding beyond the repeat kidney function?
